comparison.objective: Remove a loaded drawer from slides by pressing both disconnect levers while pulling it free.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous bimanual latch actuation and controlled extraction while protecting glass cargo.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer is removed only while both levers are pressed, with jars intact; numeric motion/damage thresholds are not given.
comparison.reason: Tests synchronized latch release under load, not tool-on-insert alignment, hammer impact, fracture, or fragment containment.
